title: Applications are invited for 36th Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 9th-13th March 2026.
bodyHtml:
Applications are invited for 36th Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 9th-13th March 2026.

Mode: Online

Registration Fee: Rs. 2000/-

Last Date of Registration: 4th March 2026

Organized By: National Coordination Centre- Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
